description: US Customs ACE system status from CBP's Cargo Systems Messaging Service (CSMS): latest messages for ACE/ABI with number, date, title, link and a type (outage, delay, resolved, maintenance window, quota bulletin, HTS update, information), plus whether an unresolved outage or delay appears in the latest messages. Data is CBP's public CSMS feed; CBP does not publish a live uptime meter. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

type.description: Optional filter: outage, maintenance, resolved, quota, hts, information

title: Logistics Cbp Ace System Status
